context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren discuss the sales office structure.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business org; vocabulary (営業/事務所/理事/運営/業務) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新しい営業の事務所を、開きたい。
lines.en: I want to open a new sales office.
lines.style: decisive boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: その事務所の運営は、誰が?
lines.style: engaged young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 理事の一人に、運営を任せる。
lines.en: I'll entrust operations to a director.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 営業の業務は、増えますか?
lines.style: thoughtful young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ああ、業務は確実に増えるだろう。
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 理事会で、承認は得られますか?
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 理事に、丁寧に説明するつもりだ。
lines.en: I intend to explain carefully to the directors.
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm closing clarity throughout
